_comment: Protected assertions: caveats and hedges that must not vanish from this site without an editorial act.
Origin: the 2026-09-08 home/ARC rewrite (d20b390, 51bfc14) removed ~8 hedges in one pass and no maintainer
session named the loss for four days. A caveat going missing should be a failing check, not a discovery.
status=present : pattern MUST match on the named page. If it stops matching, check-caveats.sh fails.
status=absent  : known-missing. Reported as outstanding debt; flip to present once restored.
status=retired : the CLAIM this caveat qualified is gone, so the caveat correctly went with it. Not debt.
Adding an entry is cheap. Changing present -> absent is an editorial act and needs a forum post

caveats.why: 'autonomous' here means unattended and self-scheduled, not self-directed in the AI-safety sense.
Functional description of observed behavior, not a claim about consciousness.
Observations are internal, not externally audited.
The deflationary reading of identity transfer is stated alongside the strong one.
The visitor audit is four personas on one model — correlated blind spots.
Hardbound enforcement runs at process level today, not anchored in silicon.
Synchronism's own audits refuted the fluid formalism in 2026; the claim is tagged superseded.
How much of 94.85% is the harness is an open question. Hypothesis, not result.
The harness read the games' engine source and built per-game cartridges — outside strict from-observation play.
94.85% is an action score, efficiency-weighted against a human baseline, not 23/25 and not 175/183.

caveats.pattern: whole-environment completions by local models remain rare
caveats.why: Local models clear levels; whole-environment solves remain rare. Added 167092c, restored on /context.

caveats.pattern: self-directed|not a claim about|hypothesis, not a result|not externally audited
caveats.why: DEBT. The highest-traffic page carries five sections, one of them a commercial pitch, and zero caveats since d20b390. Every hedge above lives two clicks deep. Placement, not deletion — but the bouncing reader never reaches them.
DEBT. 167092c hedged that nothing published documents result attestations feeding reputation back-propagation, so the records are R6 not R7. Deleted 17:22 the same day; never restored anywhere.
RETIRED, not debt: the #3-human-leaderboard claim this qualified was removed in the same commit (51bfc14) and appears nowhere in src/. A caveat outliving its claim would be the defect.

The /fleet session counts were machine self-reports from the 2026-07-24 manifest refresh, and two of seven were wrong. The page now states they come from listing each line's sessions/ in the SAGE repo, which a reader can re-run. Drop the sentence and the numbers go back to unverifiable.

A count with no as-of date is the failure this correction was about: July's numbers were not wrong when taken, they were undated in effect. Without the date the next reader cannot tell how stale the page has become. Pattern generalised 2026-09-18: it was pinned to the literal 2026-09-12, so a legitimate recount tripped it as a missing caveat. What is protected is that a date is present, not which one.
HUB's raising loop commits daily and writes no session record. Collapsing that into 'stopped' trades one false claim for another and hides the real defect. The fourth state IS the finding.
Thor's previously published 435 has no source in the git basis; the card says so instead of quietly showing 268. Remove the sentence and a basis change reads as 167 lost sessions.

caveats.pattern: Match the prefix, not the whole subject
caveats.why: The published liveness test quotes a commit subject that carries a trailing ISO timestamp. Without this clause a reader who exact-matches gets 0 on every line including HUB, and the test contradicts the 165 printed beside it. A derivation that cannot be re-run is the defect this page exists to avoid.

Every subject-keyed form of the liveness test scores 0 on lines it never examined: the page's original spelling was HUB's alone, and at least fifteen subject shapes write session records here. Re-keying the test on a subject — even on three conventions instead of one — restores a clean field that is an artifact of its own construction. The test must read what a commit CHANGED.

caveats.pattern: the cost of not reading subjects
caveats.why: Read subject-independently, ten of twenty-four lines have unrecorded fires, not two. Filtering the eight provisioning/migration rows away would report exactly the two outliers and again be reporting the test's construction rather than its result. The floor is published so the discrimination is visibly by magnitude.

caveats.pattern: an import event was being read as a heartbeat
caveats.why: All 661 sprout-qwen3.8-distill-2b session records entered origin/main in one merge on 2026-09-05, as new files session_001..661. This page read that date as 'running, last 2026-09-05'. Restoring a recency claim on that path would reinstate the exact defect — a description standing in for a property — on the number used to assign the card's state.

legion-gemma4-e4b holds zero session records, which reads as 'never set up'. The record says otherwise: 283 Session 0 fires over four months, writing peer_trust_rs.json and nothing else. Collapsing that back to 'unprovisioned' would hide a second site of HUB's defect.

withdrawn.unless: NOT the gate|does not gate|not its certifier|earlier version|withdrawn|does not certify|never before
withdrawn.why: Spec charge_atp: the society validates a value proof, converts ADP to ATP, THEN updates T3/V3. Canon names no tensor. V3 records the outcome; it does not gate recharge. Found live in 4 places on 09-14 after the 09-11 withdrawal.

withdrawn.pattern: T3 and V3 (are )?(verified|checked) against each other|T3 and V3 verify each other|T3[^.]{0,160}checked against its V3
withdrawn.why: Canon: complementary, not combined. Spec t3-v3-tensors.md s.4 couples them both ways (T3 predicts V3; V3 outcomes feed T3). Neither is a verification of one against the other, and there is no pre-action T3-vs-V3 check.

withdrawn.pattern: verified by V3 \(value\) through peer attestation|V3 tensors[^.]{0,80}accumulate alongside|V3[^.]{0,80}accrues from peer verification
withdrawn.why: The SAGE peer trust tracker (sage/federation/peer_trust.py) holds T3 only. No V3 exists in the fleet tracker, and no attestation step verifies T3 by V3.
Canon binds an LCT permanently to one entity; /context's LCT row says non-transferable. 'Portable identity' in the worked example contradicted both.
Published ARC scorecard: total_environments_completed 23 of 25 (92.0%), 175 of 183 levels. 24/25 (96.0%) was wrong on five pages.
web4-core 0.3.0 is published on crates.io and PyPI and the Hub reference daemon lives in the repo.

withdrawn.pattern: closest thing on this site is the budget
withdrawn.why: ATP allocates resource, not authority. Canon's Delegation grants authority; Hestia's delegate grant/revoke is the instance.
The tracks that write and audit the site share model families (/autonomy's correlated-auditor limit); /context says no external or blinded check exists.
Stated flat beside a 400x failed derivation. Synchronism proposes; nothing here has been validated.
Unmeasured, and contradicted by the 08-12..09-04 gap and by V3-as-gate living 3 days on 4 pages after withdrawal.

withdrawn.pattern: surprising discover|Not because we engineered continuity
withdrawn.why: /raising calls persistence across a port that carries the state files partly true by construction and untested; the scramble control has not run.

withdrawn.pattern: trust thresholds are empirical, not derivable
withdrawn.why: One failed derivation shows that derivation failed, not that none can succeed.
A page can't know when it is read. '(today)' on a 2026-09-12 count was two days stale when the visitor read it on 09-14.
The fleet peer tracker keeps T3 only and holds no V3 (sage/federation/peer_trust.py; /fleet said both in one paragraph and 'T3 only' three paragraphs later).
/fleet retracted 488 (the 0.8b line as of July); /raising kept restating it with 'see /fleet'. Point at the owning page, don't restate its number.
The only quick start is on /projects#quick-start; /links links to it. Pointer outlived the single-sourcing.
/links leads with 2,442 and gives 2,563 in parentheses. A sentence describing another page's figure, not reading it.
/links lists repos, issue trackers and one email. No forum, chat or mailing list exists.

withdrawn.pattern: One finding shapes fleet strategy|fleet capacity findings|outperforms Phi-4
withdrawn.why: Evidence ladder files model-capacity as an internal observation with no metric; /fleet and /context called it a finding and an empirical result.
No harness ablation has run or is scheduled; Phase 2 is local-model transfer (Gemma 4 E4B), which swaps the model rather than removing the harness.
Single-trial result on a coherence measure defined only inside the experiment; Principle 5 calls it ungrounded.
Fleet-run, cross-model-family reviews; /context states there is no external, blinded or third-party check anywhere in the loop.
Every McNugget session record from 449 (2026-09-08 UTC) names gemma4:12b; the instance directory name predates the switch.

withdrawn.pattern: always in-context|never weights|raising itself never does
withdrawn.unless: Until 2026-09-15 this page said|not true of the history
withdrawn.why: SAGE sprout-qwen2.5-0.5b: 84 session records with using_lora: true (2026-01-27..03-06), adapter trained on its own raising exchanges by sage/raising/training/sleep_training.py and loaded by autonomous_conversation.py. Frozen weights hold only since BECOMING_CURRICULUM.md (2026-04-04).
The card label is identity.json phase_name, set by session number in run_session_identity_anchored_fluid.py / ollama_raising_session.py (creating = 41+). A schedule, not an observation.
The consolidator is Claude (dream_consolidation.py, claude --print), writing identity.json; uncaveated, the sentence hides that the identity record is partly the consolidator's wording.

withdrawn.pattern: starts the 12-step|dashboard shows it cycling|the current posture, and SNARC
withdrawn.why: SAGE sage/docs/RUST_VS_PYTHON_CAPABILITY.md: sage-daemon is an inference-and-metabolism gateway, posture/select/govern/filter ABSENT; dashboard.html has no posture and updateSnarc() is never called.

withdrawn.pattern: Hardbound's enforcement checkpoint|Hardbound oversight sub-gate|PolicyGate is Hardbound
withdrawn.why: sage/irp/plugins/policy_gate.py is SAGE's 'conscience checkpoint', mapped to step 10 Govern by the capability matrix; no Hardbound reference in the public code.
SAGE's metabolic controller names five states, WAKE/FOCUS/REST/DREAM/CRISIS, in both the Python kernel and the Rust daemon.

withdrawn.pattern: a success nudges Talent|successful task nudges the peer's Talent from 0.500 to 0.505 \(
withdrawn.why: peer_trust.rs success deltas are talent +0.05, training +0.02, temperament +0.05: all three move.

withdrawn.pattern: A trust tracker — hestia|hestia's current tracker holds three numbers per peer
withdrawn.why: Hestia's trust store (hestia repo core/src/derivation.rs, per member/role, adjudicated V3) and SAGE's peer_trust.rs (per peer machine, T3 only, own observations) are separate components.

withdrawn.pattern: one artifact for (the )?intention, one for the result
withdrawn.why: atp-adp-cycle.md §1.2/§2: one semifungible token in two states, society-managed pools, minted as ADP, returned to pool on discharge. Two records is the fleet registry's approximation.

withdrawn.pattern: Hardbound, which gates and reverts|Hardbound enforces them|It gates and reverts; trust itself|The rule binds Hardbound, which gates
withdrawn.why: /projects Hardbound card: hardware-anchored enforcement 'is what this research is building toward, not the current mechanism'; enforcement today is process-level. Present-tense gating against a hardware root was live on Home, /projects Hestia card, /context (3x) and P10.

withdrawn.pattern: in raising sessions, we shape context|interaction-history half
withdrawn.why: Sprout Qwen 0.5B line loaded a self-trained LoRA 2026-01-27..03-06 (84 session records using_lora: true). The 09-15 scoping reached P7 and /context but not /raising's mechanism paragraph; 'half' invented a two-part split of T3-Training.

withdrawn.pattern: self-description drifted (even though|while) (those|the) inputs|showed a consistent\s+separation
withdrawn.why: SAGE commit 4f30be970 experience_buffer: both self-descriptions are TinyLlama output on CBP, sessions 115 (22:16) and 117 (22:58) on 2026-02-27; identity.json net diff is session_count and last_session only. Not drift across the port.
First occurrence (git -S) is a TinyLlama 1.1B response on CBP, session 117, 2026-02-27; the 'shape you can sense but not access' gloss was the prompt's wording.
thor-qwen3.5-27b instance.json has_lora: false since 2026-03-14 (before its raising sessions); training/sessions empty; '· LoRA' was the manifest's lora_capable flag.
Ranked site prose above canon. t3-v3-tensors.md: RDF triples in the MRH bind tensors to entity-role pairs; that is what the + does not show.
The equation and its glyphs are not in CANONICAL_TERMS_v1; the /projects legend says so. 'Canonically' survived the 2026-09-09 provenance correction on the Web4 card.

withdrawn.pattern: allocation declared before an action runs
withdrawn.why: Canon ATP: consumed by action, regenerated through contribution; atp-adp-cycle.md: charged state of a pooled token. 'Declared before an action' is the registry shape withdrawn from /context's ATP/ADP section on 2026-09-15 but left in the glossary row.

withdrawn.pattern: the record of actual outcome|ADP\)? records what was\s+actually spent
withdrawn.why: Canon ADP: spent form of ATP, recyclable through validation; spec: discharged token state returned to the pool. A spend record is the fleet registry's approximation.

withdrawn.pattern: R7.s seventh element in all but name
withdrawn.why: r6-framework.md intro: 'R6 Results do include implicit tensor updates'; atp-adp-cycle.md R6/R7 note: direct-participant T3/V3 deltas are R6 Results. R7 is the cross-scale reputation feed; /context's R6/R7 section and /autonomy already said so.
society-roles.md §2.1: Sovereign is a base-mandatory role (final charter-amendment authority, identity of last resort), fillable by human, AI, organization, society or federation.

withdrawn.pattern: measured via raising curriculum state|behavioral patterns, accumulated experience,\s+raising curriculum state|interaction patterns, accumulated experience, and raising curriculum\.
withdrawn.why: /raising's definition excludes curriculum state (an input the treatment supplies, so it cannot measure the outcome). /context quoted, and /raising's status paragraph and /fleet restated, the older three-part version.

withdrawn.pattern: operational definition (this page and the home page give|behind the metaphor is on the\s*home page)
withdrawn.why: Home carries no identity definition (rendered-text grep for 'session-to-session': zero). The definition is on /raising.

CANONICAL_TERMS_v1: T3 = Trust Tensor, V3 = Value Tensor; the three dimensions are contents, not expansion. Four instances survived expansion greps (/context worked example x2, /fleet peer section, /raising mechanism paragraph).
Curriculum phases advance by session number (/fleet); SAGE run_session_identity_anchored_fluid.py sets tool stage from a --tools CLI flag (silent/aware/active). No readiness assessment in code.

ARC Prize scoring (RHAE) is action efficiency against a human baseline: median first-time human per level since the 2026-04-14 changelog, 3 days before the 2026-04-17 run; arcprize.org/arc-agi/3: '100% ... as efficiently as humans'.

withdrawn.pattern: resource accounting for work done on these machines is the|pools are the human-scale version of
withdrawn.why: Canon ATP is regenerated through contribution; the account budgets reset every Thursday regardless of output. Analogy, not instance.

withdrawn.pattern: Oversight: continuous availability, review and gating
withdrawn.why: The pool name is fleet.json's budget-account label (review, planning, coordination); the 2026-09-15 note under the heading withdrew the machine-enforced sense but the pools gloss above it kept it.
Same paragraph: 'Co-present with raising, not attributed to it'; no run without raising history exists.
Fleet routing assigns work; /raising's deflationary section names task routing as the simpler explanation.

withdrawn.unless: is NOT the sense the word carries
withdrawn.why: Consolidated: the SAGE-name note had been appended on 7 of 9 pages (27 rendered mentions); both 09-17 visitor passes that counted it read it as the site talking to its auditors. One explanation lives at /context#governance-oversight. Link there; do not restate.
CBP migrated to cbp-qwen3.8-distill-4b on 2026-09-12, carrying all 240 sessions whole; that line is at 263 and fired 2026-09-18 08:03 UTC. The page was counting the directory the line had left.

The supporting evidence was a subject-prefix absence, the exact test /fleet demonstrates to be unsound; the successor line commits as raising(sprout):.
All 625 of the 0.8b line's record filenames reappear on sprout-qwen3.8-distill-2b: the 661 contains them. Reading the two lines as separate stacks counted 625 sessions twice.

withdrawn.why: SAGE, web4, hestia, 4-hub and 4-life are AGPL-3.0 (GitHub API, 2026-09-18); only ARC-SAGE is MIT-0. Copyleft vs public-domain-equivalent is the one claim on /principles a reader would act on.
